manifest: JM Build Route Manifest v0.1 — Host Adapter Conformance / Universal Plug Tester

created_for.body: JM Host Adapter Conformance — Universal Plug Tester v1.0
created_for.body_type: Estate-wide host-adapter proof standard / executable conformance harness
created_for.intended_destination: Canonical JM sovereign-agent runtime layer on main

source_authority: JM ChatGPT Host Adapter v0.1.x lineage
authority.owner_instruction: Go on then — build the universal host-adapter plug tester.

foundation.recovered_gap: The sovereign core and portable Node/Python runtime were proven, but host surfaces still lacked one universal executable conformance standard that prevented transport/function/contact/owner proof inflation.
foundation.reuse_rule: Use existing hosted-body law and adapter precedents; do not create a new agent or new source identity for each host.

true_gaps.gap: Host routes existed at different proof levels, but there was no one executable adapter-proof ladder/gate set spanning reference runtimes, ChatGPT/MCP, browser, Android, Codex/repository, CI/cloud and future hosts.

registry_integrity.criterion: Every adapter descriptor has unique identity, exact gate set, valid proof level and durable evidence for PASS claims.

local_reference_plugs.criterion: Python and Node execute and emit byte-identical core capsules for multiple queries; unknown query returns no fabricated route.

proof_inflation_guard.criterion: No adapter may claim a proof level unless all gates required by that level are PASS.

downstream_agent_contract.criterion: Sovereign agent validator must match the exact registered adapter IDs and proof ladder.

external_host_contact.criterion: ChatGPT inline, Android, Codex and each exact future host advance only by direct contact; OPEN is preserved until then.

host_and_surfaces.keeper: CHANGE THE PLUG, NOT THE BODY.

current_escalations: If a PASS gate lacks durable evidence, lower only that adapter's claim rather than weakening the gate.
If Node/Python parity fails, correct adapter behavior and rerun.
If a host has no adapter, add the thinnest wrapper and preserve the same conformance contract.
Never promote transport proof to live-host/owner proof without direct contact.
escalation.failure_route: FAIL LOCAL → TRACE ADAPTER/GATE → CORRECT RESPONSIBLE SURFACE → RETEST → ADVANCE ONLY THAT ADAPTER
escalation.manual_user_contact: Only for an exact owner/device/contact action that cannot be lawfully automated.

next_route.step: Open PR → run universal plug tester and downstream gates → correct attributable failures → merge on green → read canonical main.

manifest_proof.result: PASS — recovered existing host/body law and proof states, created one universal gate set without inventing cross-host proof, and preserved explicit OPEN boundaries.
